title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we collect, protect, and handle your data
content:
oldmangotree respects and safeguards the personal privacy of our readers and subscribers.

### Information Collection
- We only collect personal details (such as name and email address) voluntarily provided during account registration, newsletter subscriptions, or reader comments.
- We never sell, rent, or trade reader data to third-party marketing or advertising networks.

### Cookies
- Cookies are strictly used to enhance user experience, remember reading preferences, and maintain secure authentication sessions.

### Security
- All data transmissions and storage adhere to state-of-the-art encryption standards and secure protocols.
